status: DRAFT - ranked from the written planner rules below, not from engine scores. A team member acting as planner must review and re-order by hand before this is quoted as a result.
rules: 1. Data that stops planning entirely comes first (nothing else can be acted on).
2. Then production shortages, earliest week first; at equal week, the one with no recovery path (blocked supplier) before a late delivery.
3. Then the root causes behind those shortages (supplier restriction, revision gap in the ECN).
5. Per-week repeats of a root cause already listed come last.
